human_labeling.candidate_sample: Every actually returned first 15 candidates; no model score, status or rank shown to reviewer.

rules: Freeze version, model, query plan, documents and source coverage for every evaluated run.
Current audited directions are development regressions. Their results cannot establish blind accuracy.
Published blind directions here are unsealed proposals. Supply a separately sealed external protocol before blind execution.
Judge lifecycle at the displayed candidate granularity independently of the application score or category.
Report early-weak-signal and emerging precision separately; include yield and all planned directions.
Do not require the automatic runner to manufacture internal confirmed labels before human scientific evaluation.
Assisted runs must be distinguished and retain attributed review records; automatic runs cannot be relabeled assisted after seeing labels.
If held-out failures drive changes, this set becomes validation and a new sealed set is required.
An internal agent review is not an independent external subject-matter review.
Do not use a current-data rerun as evidence of historical forecasting performance.
Candidate gates are initial project targets, not achieved metrics or calibrated scientific standards.
